calls.reasoning: The board already shows the add path. The other two commands go through the same entry point and read the same ledger file, so they belong beside add, and the rounding rule matters most for total.
calls.text:
The board has the `add` path. Here are the other two commands, wired the same way:

```board
file src/commands/list.js as list
file src/commands/total.js as total
note Totals round once, after summing cents as rounding
f2 -> list dispatches
f2 -> total dispatches
list -> f5 reads
total -> f5 reads
rounding --> total
```

`list` and `total` both read `ledger.txt` through `ledger-file.js`; only `add` writes. Accept the additions to put them on the board.
